title: Sri Lanka Family Escape
headline: Two beach nights, then Colombo before you fly.
description: Three nights for a family: Bentota sand and a pool, then a last night in Colombo.
image_alt: Nine Arches Bridge and a train in the hills near Ella, Sri Lanka
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room type and child ages. A river boat or city evening sits outside the base figure unless you ask us to include it.
overview: A short family Sri Lanka: two nights on a west-coast beach the children can use, then Colombo for an easy airport morning. Built for school-holiday weekends.
highlights: Two nights at a family beach hotel in Bentota.
Private vehicle from and to Colombo airport.
A quiet Colombo night before departure.
Pace short enough for younger children.
why: Two stays, not a hotel every night.
Pool and beach time before anyone is tired of the road.
The same driver stays with you.
inclusions: Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
exclusions: River boats and city tickets unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
